record_type_quote: The replicated and refined algorithms were evaluated on an independent dataset with the same metrics as in the original publication.

targets.title: Automated drusen segmentation and quantification in SD-OCT images.
targets.evidence_quote: Specifically, we re-implemented an algorithm for drusen quantification on OCT proposed by Chen et al . 13 , which we identified as an established algorithm that was reported to achieve strong results in a previous systematic literature review 8 .
targets.outcome_quote: In conclusion, we replicated a reportedly well-performing algorithm for OCT-based drusen quantification and found algorithm performance to be inferior to the reported results for various reasons. Several refinements considerably improved algorithm performance in our sample but still did not achieve published results.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The finding tested is the reported segmentation accuracy, which was not achieved on the independent dataset, even after refinements.

reasoning: Reimplementation alone would not establish new-sample replication, but this paper explicitly evaluates whether published accuracy generalizes to an independent patient dataset and compares the corresponding metrics. Original data were unavailable. It therefore meets replication rather than reproduction or methods-only criteria.
